correctness.rationale: Hermitian lifting reduces intensity equality to the absence of an indefinite rank-at-most-2 matrix in the nine-real-dimensional measurement kernel. Four square points force D=-r^2 E, A=-r^2 B-r^4 C and Re F=0; the two t-antipodes and s-diagonal antipodes reduce the kernel to one Hermitian generator with off-diagonal i Delta when r,s,t are pairwise noncolliding as specified. Its determinant vanishes exactly when ((s^2-r^2)(s^2-t^2))^2=4r^2 s^4 t^2. In that case the explicit quadratic vs linear ambiguity matches all nodes. With repeated radii or at most 7 samples, a Hermitian kernel plane has an indefinite rank-2 element. Quadratic resonance split yields two outer exceptions and zero/two inner exceptions separated at ratio 2+sqrt(3), a double inner value at equality. Independent symbolic rank and resonance checks corroborated; finite examples not a substitute for full linear elimination.
